description: A stop-loss whose brain is a small neural network living inside a Reactive contract. It watches the Chainlink ETH/USD feed on Lasna, decides HOLD / TRIM / EXIT (and buys back in, in two tranches) entirely on-chain, and executes its own protection callbacks into a vault on Base Sepolia. This manifest describes the agent connector layer: an MCP server that reads the live system and prepares — never signs, never sends — deposit transactions for an agent's own wallet.
limits: Testnet only (Lasna + Base Sepolia); nothing here is real money.
Deposits join one shared vault position — no per-user accounting in this demo.
Withdrawals from the vault are owner-only; deposited test WETH cannot be withdrawn by the depositor.
The safe asset is MockUSDC, a mock token (owner-only mint, no public faucet).
The MCP server holds no keys and never broadcasts transactions; it only reads chains and prepares calldata.
name: Sentinel — an AI-guarded stop-loss
